CAVEAT recorded in the output: N=120, sd~6, SE ~0.6 dB, so adjacent sparsity levels are NOT separable and the sweep is non-monotonic (50% scores above 30%) - frozen BatchNorm statistics vs pruning-shifted activation scales. Read the trend, not the row ranking. Artifact: eval/pruning_sweep.txt
